systems.system: Portable registration kits for civil registration
systems.country_label: Portable registration kits for civil registration
systems.owner: Ministry of Interior and National Administration (requesting); not funded
systems.tiers: not stated; a new request for World Bank KDEAP funding put by the government at the mission of 6-16 October 2025, which the mission asked it to prioritise against the unprogrammed budget

note: A World Bank mission record on a digital economy project: it describes no civil registration system. It says the mission encouraged the ICT Authority to prioritise the equipment needs of citizen-facing entities such as civil registration offices in the next devices procurement, and lists as unfunded new requests portable registration kits for civil registration and the digitalisation of an estimated 400 million paper records at the Ministry of Interior, without saying whose records those are.
